title: Pytest Output Reader
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Software Testing for Robotics
description: Read six real pytest failure messages from the lab's code, each with a bug put in on purpose, and decide which of six causes each one points to. Explore mode explains every cause and the fix it usually needs. Used in Chapter 13.

learningObjectives: Attribute each of six pytest failure messages to its most likely cause, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Read each cause and its usual fix, then attribute real failure messages to their causes
keyQuestions: Which messages show a problem in the test and not in the code?
commonMisconceptions: A failing test always means that the code is wrong
Exact equality is fine for decimals
An error before any test runs is a test failure
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed attributions, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Six cause buttons (Explore: read about a cause; quiz: commit an answer)
Next message / See score / Try again
